references.text: Jesus' enemies pick up stones to stone him, just as in John 8:59, but he avoids being caught this time.
Jesus' disciples remind him that the Jews recently tried to stone him, showing that stoning was a recurring threat against him.
The Jews sought to kill Jesus because he broke the Sabbath and called God his own Father, which led them to pick up stones to stone him.
Jesus' enemies again tried to seize him, but he escaped their hands, just as he escaped the stoning in the temple.
No one seized Jesus until his hour had come, even though he was teaching in the temple, underscoring that his hiding in 8:59 was a temporary escape.
